subject: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 redstone-wire power into a command block directly below

observed_source_semantics.command_block_neighbor_update: BlockCommandBlock.onNeighborBlockChange evaluates World.isBlockPowered(commandPos) before scheduling command execution.
observed_source_semantics.wire_power_query: World.getRedstonePower delegates a non-normal-cube redstone-wire neighbor to BlockRedstoneWire.getWeakPower(world, wirePos, wireState, facing).
observed_source_semantics.wire_up_side: BlockRedstoneWire.getWeakPower returns the wire POWER value when the queried side is EnumFacing.UP.

inference_boundary: This receipt supports only redstone wire immediately above a Minecraft 1.8.8 legacy command block.
It does not establish generic vertical redstone adjacency, arbitrary dust-to-component power, opaque-solid conduction, quasi-connectivity, or repeating/chain command-block behavior.
Static causal support remains distinct from runtime command execution, client delivery, player perception, comprehension, and qualitative value.
